findings: An infiltrative pancreatic cancer measuring 44 mm is observed in the tail of the pancreas. Serosal invasion and retropancreatic tissue invasion are noted. There is contact of 180° or more with the splenic artery, suggesting invasion. Invasion into the left adrenal gland is also observed. No other local invasion factors are noted. Lymph node metastases are identified in two nodes at station 9 and two nodes at station 10. No other evident metastases are observed.

responses.content:
Task 1: Diagnose the local invasion factors of pancreatic cancer.

CH0 (no invasion into the common hepatic artery)
DU0 (no invasion into the duodenum)
S1 (serosal invasion)
RP1 (retropancreatic tissue invasion)
PV0 (no invasion into the portal vein)
A1 (invasion into the left adrenal gland)
PL0 (no invasion into the portal lymph nodes)
OO1 (contact of 180° or more with the splenic artery, suggesting invasion)

Task 2: Determine the classification for local invasion (T classification) of pancreatic cancer.

Based on the size of the tumor (44 mm) and the presence of serosal invasion, invasion into the retropancreatic tissue, and invasion into the left adrenal gland, the T classification is T3.

Task 3: Determine the N classification of pancreatic cancer.

Regional lymph nodes for pancreatic cancer in the tail are:
- Station 9 (left gastric artery lymph nodes)
- Station 10 (common hepatic artery lymph nodes)
- Station 11 (splenic artery lymph nodes)
- Station 12 (splenic lymph nodes)
- Station 13 (left adrenal gland lymph nodes)

The patient's metastatic lymph node stations are:
- Station 9
- Station 10

These are regional lymph nodes. Counting only the metastatic lymph nodes within the regional stations, there are 4 involved regional nodes.

N classification: N1b

Task 4: Determine the M classification of pancreatic cancer.

There are no distant metastases observed, so the M classification is M0.

Task 5: Determine the resectability classification of pancreatic cancer.

Based on the presence of serosal invasion and invasion into the left adrenal gland, the tumor is Unresectable (UR).

Task 6: Determine the overall stage according to the JPS staging system.

T classification: T3
N classification: N1b
M classification: M0

Based on the T classification, the tumor is classified as T3. Based on the N classification, the tumor is classified as N1b. Based on the M classification, the tumor is classified as M0.

The overall stage is Stage III.
